entries.headline: Weasel Pit and Other Indie Developers Report Clone-Game Extortion Emails
entries.summary: AUTOMATON, citing InTheIndie, reports that indie developers received emails demanding $200 in Steam content within 24 hours or threatening to release clones of their games first. Weasel Pit, developer of Iron Pilgrim, shared an email containing a video apparently made with generative AI. Whether an actual clone exists remains unconfirmed.

entries.headline: ARC Raiders Offers Limited Free Play from October 8 to 12
entries.summary: Nexon announced limited free play for ARC Raiders on Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S from October 8 at 6 PM to October 12 at 5 PM Japan time. New players can access Pendra Pass by teaming up with a player who has already unlocked the map.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE: ACE COMBAT 8 Reaches a Reported Steam Peak of 37,214 Players
entries.summary: AUTOMATON recorded a Steam concurrent-player peak of 37,214 for ACE COMBAT 8, compared with 13,758 for its predecessor. These are the report's captured observations. The games had different PC and console launch schedules, so the figures do not establish total sales.
